description: SIPB also clears 10 IT, quantum projects worth over Rs 500 crore which are set to create 9,000 jobs.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh cleared fresh industrial investments worth Rs 22,177.84 crore across 28 projects, expected to generate employment for 19,739 people, the state government said. The approvals came at the 21st meeting of the State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB), chaired by Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu on Friday (September 18). The projects span sectors including energy, IT and communications, food processing, manufacturing and tourism.
